svg.title: Call graph (computed from the source)
svg.desc: Which function calls which, from the four HTTP entry points down to the core primitives.

g.text: Parsed with Python's ast module: 38 functions, 49 calls. Private helpers (names starting
with _) are folded into their public caller. Five small helpers are left out: audit, canonical_json, edges, incoming, live_available.
Method calls on objects are not followed.
